_comment: Bundled model registry. 'active' picks the default client; reference any client in code as 'hosting/model'. Field precedence: model > hosting > defaults.

hostings._comment_api_tokens: Cloud hostings raise max_new_tokens to 16000 (reasoning models count thinking tokens against it). A model with sampling=false rejects temperature/top_p/top_k, so they are dropped.

gemini._comment: Google AI Studio, via LiteLLM's native 'gemini/' provider. 2.5 models take thinking_budget; 3.x models take reasoning_effort (mapped to thinking_level).

vertex_ai._comment: Same Gemini models via Vertex AI (Application Default Credentials).

anthropic._comment: Anthropic's own API, via LiteLLM's native 'anthropic/' provider.

openrouter._comment: OpenAI, Claude and Gemini through one OpenRouter key. IDs are OpenRouter's own.
openrouter._comment_prices: notes = OpenRouter $/1M tokens (in / out) and Artificial Analysis (AA) index. ':free' models: 20 req/min, 50 req/day (1000 with $10+ credits).

models.name: gemma-4-31b-free
notes: free

models.name: qwen3.8-27b-free
notes: free · AA 34

ollama._comment: OpenAI-compatible local server; no api_key needed.

mlx_vlm._comment: macOS / Apple Silicon. Uses the same HuggingFace model IDs the server was started with.

vllm._comment: HuggingFace model IDs, each served by `vllm serve <model_id>`.
vllm._comment_dtype: vLLM picks the dtype: bf16 where supported; on V100 (below sm_80) fp16, or fp32 for models it bans from fp16 (Gemma 2/3).
vllm._comment_notes: Flags in notes are extra `vllm serve` flags, not fields here.
vllm._comment_tokens: max_new_tokens: the 4096 default, 8192 on reasoning models (thinking counts against it); prompt + output must fit --max-model-len (32768 in test_vllm.sh).

transformers._comment_quantization: quantization_level: null (full precision) or '4bit' (NF4, CUDA only — ignored elsewhere).
transformers._comment_dtype: fallback_dtype: dtype for GPUs without native bfloat16 (sm < 80); null keeps bfloat16, emulated there (slow).
transformers._comment_processor: processor_kwargs: extra args passed to AutoProcessor.from_pretrained, only where needed. Idefics3: do_image_splitting=false skips upscaling/tiling each frame (~3000 -> ~175 tokens/frame).
